pages.title: MSc Artificial Intelligence
body: I am interested in embodied and physically grounded AI, in particular systems that combine a learned policy with parts you can analyse and explain.
Most of my projects are research projects. You can find them under projects.

pages.title: BSc Artificial Intelligence
pages.meta: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. GPA 9.0 out of 10
body: Honours Programme in Computer Science and a minor in Situated AI. Courses included Machine Learning, Robotics, Reinforcement Learning and Conversational AI.
My thesis on drone navigation, ZEPHYR, was graded 9.5 and supervised by Mauricio Verano Merino and Vincent François-Lavet.
